# Known-answer files

Files the test agent may upload to a tested site when a claim needs one. None of them holds a real
person's details. Only the files in the table can be uploaded; this README never is.

| File | What it is | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `test_resume.pdf` | The made-up test resume (Asha Verma), the same file as `testdata/resumes/test_resume.pdf`. Rebuild both with `python testdata/resumes/make_test_resume.py` | Made by the TalNex team for testing; free to use |
| `dog.jpg` | A clear photo of one basset hound holding a flower, for image captioning and recognition claims (a correct answer mentions a dog). "Basset-hound-flower 20240122" by Palmarin776, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Basset-hound-flower_20240122_by_Palmarin776.jpg | CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication) |
